Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about playing, scoring and climbing the Worldwide Leaderboard in Music & Movie Trivia - The Game.

Music & Movie Trivia is an interactive online game platform where you can test your knowledge across 24 entertainment categories — 12 music and 12 movie. Whether you are a film buff or a music aficionado, our trivia games offer a challenging and engaging experience for players of all skill levels. Play solo, compete on the Worldwide Leaderboard, or host a game night for up to 10 players on a single device.
Select Single Player or MultiPlayer from the home screen, then choose Music Trivia or Movie Trivia. Pick a genre category that interests you — for music that might be One-Hit Wonders or The British Invasion; for movies it could be Blockbuster Hits or Sci-Fi & Fantasy. You will be presented with 10 multiple-choice questions, each with a countdown timer. Answer quickly and accurately to earn points. The faster and more accurate you are, the higher your score climbs!
Each question is assigned a specific point value based on its difficulty level — Easy, Medium, or Hard — shown clearly before you answer. Answer correctly within the time limit to earn full points. Wrong answers or letting the timer run out scores zero. In MultiPlayer mode, the player with the highest total score at the end of all rounds wins the game. Your cumulative score across all Single Player sessions is what determines your rank on the Worldwide Leaderboard.
We offer 24 unique categories across both game types. Music Trivia includes: One-Hit Wonders, The British Invasion, Boy Bands & Girl Groups, Classic Rock & Roll, The MTV Era, Motown & Soul, Divas & Crooners, Famous Duets, Country Crossovers, Grammy Glory, Movie Soundtracks, and Modern Music Challenge. Movie Trivia includes: Blockbuster Hits, Classic Hollywood, Animated Classics, Famous Movie Quotes, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Action & Adventure, Musical Melodies, Horror & Thrillers, Comedy Gold, Award Winners, Superhero Cinema, and Animal Stars.
Questions are pulled randomly from our database of 4,800 unique questions based on the category you select. Each game gives you 10 randomly chosen questions, so you will get a fresh challenge every time you play even in the same category. The database spans Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels to keep things interesting for all skill levels.
Absolutely — that is what MultiPlayer mode is built for! Select MultiPlayer on the home screen, enter the number of players (2 to 10), and type in each player's name. The game uses a hot-seat format: one device is shared and passed around the room, making it perfect for game nights, family gatherings, parties, or just hanging out in the living room. No extra devices, no app downloads, no setup fees.
In hot-seat MultiPlayer, 2 to 10 players share one device and take turns. Player 1 answers all 10 questions, then a Pass the Device screen appears so Player 2 can take their turn — and so on through all players. Scores are tracked live at the top of the screen throughout. At the end, everyone's scores are ranked so you know exactly who won. No emails are needed for MultiPlayer — all player name data is permanently erased the moment you quit the game.
You do not need an account to play MultiPlayer or to play Single Player as a Guest. However, if you want to track your historical stats and appear on the Worldwide Leaderboard, you will need to sign in with your name and email address in Single Player mode. Creating an account is free and takes only seconds.
Yes! In Single Player mode, choose Play as Guest to jump straight in without signing up. Guest scores are not saved and will not appear on the Worldwide Leaderboard. In MultiPlayer mode, no email is ever required — player names are the only information collected, and they are deleted when the game ends.
The Worldwide Leaderboard is a global ranking system showcasing the top trivia players on the platform. It tracks your total score accumulated across all Single Player game sessions, so every category you play adds to your running total. Only your display name is shown publicly — your email address is never visible to other players. Sign in as a Single Player to earn your spot.
Play in Single Player mode and sign in with your name and email address. Every game you complete as a signed-in player automatically adds your score to the Worldwide Leaderboard. The more categories you conquer, the higher you climb. Playing multiple games across different categories is the best strategy for accumulating points and reaching the top.
Yes — your privacy is our priority. Your email address is used solely as a unique identifier to track your scores across sessions and keep your leaderboard position accurate. It is never displayed publicly, never sold to third parties, and never used for marketing. We apply industry-standard security measures to protect your data at all times.
From the results screen, click Quit Game and choose Yes, Delete Everything. This permanently and immediately removes your name, email address, and all leaderboard scores from our system. If you choose No instead, you will return to the home screen with your account and scores fully intact for your next visit.
Yes, play as many games as you like — there is no limit! In fact, playing multiple games across different categories is the best way to accumulate points and climb the Worldwide Leaderboard. With 4,800 questions across 24 categories, there is always something new to challenge you.
100% free, always — no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no hidden fees. We display Google AdSense ads to keep the lights on, but every category, every question, and every leaderboard feature is completely free to use for everyone.
Definitely. Music & Movie Trivia is fully responsive and works great on smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers in all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Play wherever and whenever you want — no app download required.
You need an internet connection to load the game initially and to save or view Worldwide Leaderboard scores. Once the page has fully loaded in your browser, the game questions and core gameplay work even if your connection drops — though leaderboard updates will resume only when you are back online.
